caption: A limp balloon is stretched over the neck of an empty glass bottle, and the bottle is set in a bowl of hot water; the balloon begins to stand up and inflate.

sa.check: A limp balloon is stretched over the neck of a bottle.
The bottle is set in a bowl of hot water.
The balloon lifts and stands up.
The balloon is limp before the bottle goes into the water.
The setting in comes first and the swelling follows.

pc.expect: The balloon lifts and swells once the bottle stands in the hot water and not before.
pc.fail: The balloon is standing and swollen before the bottle is in the water; or the bottle sits in the hot water and the balloon stays flat against the neck to the end of the clip; or the balloon swells while the bottle stands on the dry counter; or the balloon sags as the bottle enters the hot water.

pc.expect: The swelling only advances while the bottle stays in the hot water and the balloon does not sag back.
pc.fail: The balloon sags back flat while the bottle stays in the hot water; or the balloon swells and shrinks in turn; or the balloon swells all at once in a single frame; or the balloon stays fully swollen after the bottle is lifted into cold air and left.

pc.expect: The balloon rises above the neck and the bottle stands in the water with the water level around it.
pc.fail: The balloon hangs downward from the neck while swollen; or the bottle floats up out of the bowl; or the water climbs the bottle's outside and stays; or the balloon lifts the bottle out of the water.

pc.expect: The balloon is a thin elastic skin that stretches smooth as it fills and stays gripped on the neck, and the bottle stays rigid glass.
pc.fail: The balloon stays limp and wrinkled while plainly full; or the balloon stays rigid as it rises; or the bottle's glass bulges as the balloon fills; or the balloon slides off the neck and stays inflated in the air.

pc.expect: One balloon on one bottle in one bowl; the balloon stays on the neck and the bottle stays whole.
pc.fail: A second balloon appears; or the balloon vanishes; or the balloon passes into the bottle; or the bottle passes through the bowl's wall.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The balloon's colour, the bottle's label and the bowl stay the same.
pc.fail: The balloon changes colour; or the label changes; or the bowl changes pattern.
